CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Smoothly return to center, level flight.
CONTROLS.NAME: recenter

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Forward flight speed in units per second.
CONTROLS.NAME: fly_speed

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How far the camera sees before fading to sky.
CONTROLS.NAME: draw_distance

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Minimum flight altitude above the ground.
CONTROLS.NAME: min_height

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Canopy fullness. 0 = bare trunks only, 1.5+ = full dense canopy.
CONTROLS.NAME: tree_density

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How much of the sky is covered by clouds. 0 = clear, 1 = overcast.
CONTROLS.NAME: cloud_cover

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Temporal blur — blends current frame with previous. Higher = smoother frosted texture, more motion trails.
CONTROLS.NAME: motion_blur

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Strength of canopy brightness pulse on bass hits.
CONTROLS.NAME: bass_reactivity

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How often a sauropod appears. 0 = none, 1 = a dino in nearly every clearing.
CONTROLS.NAME: dino_density

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Sauropod size multiplier relative to the design blockout.
CONTROLS.NAME: dino_scale

DESCRIPTION: Fly through a misty alpine pine forest at dusk, roamed by sauropods and T-rexes that flash through prismatic colors on every bass hit. Traditional conical conifers dusted with snow, distant snow-capped peaks silhouetted against the glow, and hard ground shadows cast by every trunk, canopy, and dino.
TITLE: Dino Planet
